s.note: Beef frankfurts in soft rolls under a fine, spiced beef chilli sauce with yellow mustard and chopped onion
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince with half a finely chopped onion, 1 crushed garlic clove and 1 tbsp oil, breaking it up very fine. Stir in 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp sweet paprika and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 250ml beef stock, and simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Season. Heat 8 beef frankfurts in barely simmering water for 5 minutes. Warm 8 long soft bread rolls, put a frankfurt in each, spoon over the chilli and finish with yellow mustard and the rest of the raw onion.

s.n: Effie's fried green tomatoes with hot sauce mayo
s.note: Thick slices of green tomato in a crunchy spiced polenta crust, fried golden, with hot sauce mayonnaise
s.how: Salt 4 green tomatoes cut in 1cm slices and leave for 10 minutes, then pat dry. Mix 125g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp hot sauce and 1 tsp lemon juice. Coat each slice in 100g plain flour, then 2 eggs whisked with 125ml buttermilk, then 120g fine polenta mixed with 1 tsp paprika and 1/2 tsp cayenne. Shallow fry in 250ml oil over medium high heat for about 3 minutes a side until golden. Drain, sprinkle with salt and serve hot with the mayo.

m.n: Rainbow Records Sunday fried chicken with baked mac and cheese
m.note: Buttermilk-soaked chicken in a crisp spiced coating, fried deep golden, with baked cheddar macaroni and a crunchy crumb top
m.how: Whisk 500ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp hot sauce and 1 tsp salt and turn 1.5kg chicken thighs and drumsticks through it. Marinate in the fridge for 4 hours. Boil 300g macaroni until just tender. Melt 40g butter, stir in 3 tbsp flour and whisk in 600ml milk until thick, then stir in most of 250g grated vintage cheddar and 1 tsp mustard powder and fold through the pasta. Top with the rest of the cheese and 50g breadcrumbs and bake at 180C for 25 minutes. Meanwhile heat 1.5 litres of oil to 165C. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp each garlic powder, cayenne and black pepper and 1 tsp salt. Press the chicken into the flour and fry in batches for 12 to 14 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack for 5 minutes and serve with the mac and cheese.

w.n: Lorrell and Jimmy's sweet potato pie
w.note: Silky spiced sweet potato custard in a crisp shortcrust case, with soft whipped cream
w.how: Boil 600g orange sweet potato until very soft, drain and mash until smooth. Line a 23cm pie dish with a sheet of shortcrust pastry and blind bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Whisk the sweet potato with 60g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 160ml evaporated milk, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp nutmeg and a pinch of salt. Pour into the case and bake for 45 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool for 1 hour and serve with 300ml cream whipped to soft peaks.

d.note: A sugar cube soaked in aromatic bitters under chilled sparkling wine with a twist of orange
d.how: Drop a sugar cube into each of 4 chilled flutes and soak each with 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Top slowly with 600ml chilled sparkling wine, then twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
